{{Top|leg}}
An '''uplink station''' was a building used to receive and broadcast data. The [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] operated [[SoroSuub secure uplink station|one such station]] in [[G'rinn Go city]].<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
